The Notice Template module allows users to create and manage templates for notifications. These templates provide a standardized format for messaging, ensuring consistent communication across different types of notifications. This module is useful for setting up reusable notification formats, which can then be customized with dynamic content based on the specific use case.

Fields and Descriptions

ID:

  • Description: A unique identifier for the notice template, automatically generated by the system.
  • Usage: The ID is assigned automatically and is used for referencing the specific notice template.
  • Example: "123"
  • Validation: Must be a valid numeric identifier, automatically generated.

Title:

  • Description: The title of the notice template.
  • Usage: Enter a brief, descriptive title that reflects the purpose of the notice template.
  • Example: "Maintenance Notification Template"
  • Validation: Must be a valid string and cannot be null.

Content Template:

  • Description: The content body of the notice template. This field may contain placeholders for dynamic content that will be replaced when the notice is issued.
  • Usage: Enter the core message of the template, which can include placeholders like [receiverName], [noticeDate], or other variables that will be substituted with real data when used.
  • Example: "Dear [receiverName], we would like to inform you that [event] will take place on [noticeDate]."
  • Validation: Must be a valid string, with placeholders for dynamic content. The content length should not exceed 2000 characters.
